Stories/Mira's Road/00 Crossroads.md:
---
id: sc_m1
title: Crossroads
story: story_mira

  - id: chg_6

    property: affiliations

      target: The Wanderers' Guild

[[Mira]] reaches the crossroads at first light. One road leads back to [[Ashford]]; the other climbs into the hills. She stands there longer than she means to.
Stories/Mira's Road/01 The Sword in the:
---
id: sc_m2
title: The Sword in the Ash
story: story_mira
chapter: null
order: 1
moment: m_m2
changes:
  - id: chg_4
    entity: ent_sword
    op: set
    property: owner
    value:
      kind: link
      target: Mira
    order: 0
    message: Mira pulls the sword from the ashes
---
Among the ashes of the old road, [[Mira]] finds the [[Sword of Ash]] half buried in cinders. She lifts it, and it is heavier than it should be. From now on it is hers to carry.
Stories/The Ashford Chronicle/00 Supper:
---
id: sc_1
title: Supper at the Inn
story: story_main
chapter: ch_1
order: 0
moment: m_1
changes: []
---
[[norman]] is eating his food.

Across the table, [[Alice]] and [[Bob]] argue quietly over the price of ale. The fire is low, and the [[Sword of Ash]] hangs above the hearth, black against the stones.
Stories/The Ashford Chronicle/01 The Str:
---
id: sc_2
title: The Stranger
story: story_main
chapter: ch_2
order: 1
moment: m_2
changes:
  - id: chg_5
    entity: ent_mira
    op: note
    order: 0
    message: Arrives in Ashford, watching from the doorway
---
A stranger comes in from the rain and asks for [[Norman]] by name. [[Mira]] watches from the doorway, her cloak still wet. [[Alice]] and [[Bob]] laugh together at the far table, not yet knowing what the night will cost them.
Stories/The Ashford Chronicle/02 The Bet:
---
id: sc_3
title: The Betrayal
story: story_main
chapter: ch_3
order: 2
moment: m_3
changes:
  - id: chg_1
    entity: ent_alice_bob
    op: set
    property: status
    value: enemies
    order: 0
    message: Alice sells Bob out to the mayor
  - id: chg_7
    entity: ent_alice
    op: add
    property: affiliations
    value:
      kind: link
      target: The Ashford Guard
    order: 1
    message: Takes Bob's place in the Guard
---
[[Bob]] says the words [[Alice]] will never forget. By morning their friendship lies broken on the floor of the [[Ashford]] inn.
Stories/The Ashford Chronicle/03 Gatheri:
---
id: sc_4
title: Gathering Storm
story: story_main
chapter: ch_4
order: 3
moment: m_4
changes:
  - id: chg_8
    entity: ent_mira
    op: revise
    order: 0
    message: Decides to leave before the storm
    note: |-
      Mira has walked every road between [[Ashford]] and the hills. She never stays anywhere long. #wanderer

      She has cut her hair short for the road and means to be gone before the storm breaks.
---
Clouds pile up over the hills above [[Ashford]]. [[Mira]] counts the coins in her purse and decides to leave before the storm breaks.
Stories/The Ashford Chronicle/04 The Fal:
---
id: sc_5
title: The Fall of Ashford
story: story_main
chapter: ch_5
order: 4
moment: m_5
changes:
  - id: chg_2
    entity: ent_norman
    op: set
    property: status
    value: dead
    order: 0
    message: Falls defending the inn
  - id: chg_3
    entity: ent_ashford
    op: set
    property: state
    value: ruined
    order: 0
    message: Burned in the night of the fall
---
The gates of [[Ashford]] give way at dusk. [[Norman]] falls defending the inn, and the town burns until the sky is red. Little of [[Ashford]] is left standing.
